weapon.d: Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1). During combat, neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks, prevent unit's follow-up attacks, grant "Special cooldown charge +X" to foe, or inflict "Special cooldown charge -X" on unit.

special.d: Boosts damage by 30% of unit's Atk.
Boosts damage by 30% of unit's Atk.
Boosts damage by 20% of foe's Atk. If in combat against a dragon foe or beast foe, boosts damage by 40% instead of 20%.

a.d: Unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range.

b.d: At start of turn, inflicts Spd-3 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Spd through its next action.
At start of turn, inflicts Spd-5 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Spd through its next action.
At start of turn, inflicts Spd-7 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Spd through its next action.

c.d: At start of odd-numbered turns, grants Spd+2 to unit and adjacent allies for 1 turn. (Bonus granted to unit even if no allies are adjacent.)
At start of odd-numbered turns, grants Spd+4 to unit and adjacent allies for 1 turn. (Bonus granted to unit even if no allies are adjacent.)
At start of odd-numbered turns, grants Spd+6 to unit and adjacent allies for 1 turn. (Bonus granted to unit even if no allies are adjacent.)
